brief: The canvas displays a dynamic collection of glowing, bioluminescent shapes that drift and bloom against a dark background. These vibrant forms, colored in neon and glowing blues, emit continuous, smoke-like tails that trail behind their movement. The entire composition moves constantly, giving the appearance of deep-sea life. The forms continuously adapt their density, shape, and intensity based on the subtle illumination level of the background, reacting visibly when the overall darkness shifts.
